intent: A tpunit fixture exercising most of libstuff's free-standing utility functions (crypto, JSON, HTTP parsing/composition, string/regex helpers, file IO, SQLite bound parameters) plus a few explicit security contracts.

objects.name: TempDBFile
objects.role: RAII temp file (via mkstemp) used as a throwaway SQLite db for tests

objects.name: LibStuff
objects.role: tpunit::TestFixture grouping ~37 test methods covering most of libstuff's free functions

objects.name: LibStuff::testAutoThreadPrefixRestoresPreviousValues
objects.role: SAUTOPREFIX thread-local save/restore across nested scopes

objects.name: LibStuff::testEncryptDecrpyt/testSHMACSHA1/testSHMACSHA256
objects.role: AES and HMAC-SHA1/256 primitives

objects.name: LibStuff::testJSONDecode/testJSON
objects.role: JSON parse/compose round-trips incl. float/scientific-notation/NaN-Infinity formatting

objects.name: LibStuff::testEscapeUnescape/testTrim/testCollapse/testStrip
objects.role: string escaping and whitespace utilities

objects.name: LibStuff::testChunkedEncoding/SComposeHTTPTest
objects.role: HTTP request/chunked parsing and response composition incl. header-injection escaping

objects.name: LibStuff::testDaysInMonth/testFirstOfMonth
objects.role: calendar arithmetic

objects.name: LibStuff::testGZip
objects.role: SGZip/SGUnzip round trip

objects.name: LibStuff::testConstantTimeEquals
objects.role: timing-safe string compare

objects.name: LibStuff::testParseIntegerList/testSQList/testContains
objects.role: list parsing/composing and SQL-safe list quoting across container types

objects.name: LibStuff::testSData/testSTable
objects.role: SData/STable auto-stringification of assigned native types

objects.name: LibStuff::testFileIO
objects.role: SFile* save/load/exists/size/delete

objects.name: LibStuff::testRandom
objects.role: SRandom::rand64 smoke test

objects.name: LibStuff::testHexConversion/testBase32Conversion/testEncodeDecodeURIComponent
objects.role: encoding conversions

objects.name: LibStuff::SREMatchTest/SREReplaceTest
objects.role: SRE* regex match/replace/compile wrappers

objects.name: LibStuff::testSReplace/testSReplaceAll/testSReplaceAllBut
objects.role: substring and character-set replace helpers

objects.name: LibStuff::SQResultTest/testReturningClause/testSQueryBoundParameters/testSQueryBoundParameterInjections
objects.role: SQLite/SQResult read/write, RETURNING clause, bound parameters, and SQL-injection resistance

objects.name: LibStuff::SRedactSensitiveValuesTest
objects.role: SRedactSensitiveValues log scrubbing

objects.name: LibStuff::testSGetPeerNamePreservesErrno/testResolveHost
objects.role: SGetPeerName errno preservation and SResolveHost DNS/IP resolution

objects.name: LibStuff::testUpperLower
objects.role: SToUpper/SToLower coverage; dead code, never registered in the TEST() list

objects.name: __LibStuff
objects.role: self-registers the fixture with tpunit at static-init time

misfits.why: Fully written test method for SToUpper/SToLower is never added to the constructor's TEST(...) list, so it never executes; SToUpper/SToLower have no running coverage

name_fit.note: Named for exactly what it tests: libstuff

naming_quality.note: Most methods use testXxx, but several (SREMatchTest, SQResultTest, SRedactSensitiveValuesTest, SComposeHTTPTest) suffix Test instead, inconsistent within one fixture
